apps.name: Zero to Signing
apps.description: From nothing to a registered, staked, signing Stacks signer. Prefilled where possible, post-conditions on every transaction, and the URL is the state.

apps.name: Zero to Claiming
apps.description: Claim sBTC rewards for every staker in a signer-manager pool, or only for yourself. Amounts are read from the manager before anything is signed.

apps.name: Zero to BNS
apps.description: Search, register, renew, transfer, list and buy BNSv2 names. Every price, window and default is read from the deployed contract.

apps.name: sBTC to Stacks gas
apps.description: Swap a little sBTC for STX gas in one signature, starting from zero STX. The sponsor is repaid inside the same transaction.

apps.name: sBTC Deposit Recovery
apps.description: A confirmed BTC deposit that never minted sBTC. Paste the txid: the page proves the recipient and re-registers the deposit with the signers.
